observation.command:
systemctl disable --now qisutu-install-complete.path 2>&1
rm -f /etc/systemd/system/qisutu-install-complete.path /etc/systemd/system/qisutu-install-complete.service
systemctl daemon-reload
ls -la /etc/systemd/system/ | grep -i qisutu
echo "=== start daemon"
sudo -u qisutu QISUTU_HOME=/opt/qisutu /usr/bin/perl /opt/qisutu/bin/qisutu-daemon.pl --sleep 3 --max-jobs 100 > /tmp/daemon.log 2>&1 &
sleep 6
pgrep -af qisutu-daemon | head; echo "--- log"; tail -20 /tmp/daemon.log
